The '''Nightbrother village''' was a village populated by the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located on the far side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==History==
[[File:NightbrotherArena-Monster.png|thumb|left|200px|The combat arena known as the [[Crucible (arena)|Crucible]], relatively close to the village]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], after being betrayed by her [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] master [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] visited the village in search for both a new assassin for Dooku and someone to be used for assassinating the Count himself. After merciless tests, she selected a young [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] named [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

Several days later, while searching for the source of Dooku's new assassin that left havoc on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] during the Battle for [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]], the village was visited by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
